description.zh:
堡垒机的实例ID。
> 您可以调用[DescribeInstances](~~153281~~)接口获取该参数。
description.en:
The bastion host ID.

> You can call the [DescribeInstances](~~153281~~) operation to query the bastion host ID.

description.zh:
堡垒机的地域ID。
>地域ID和地域名称的对应关系，请参见[地域和可用区](~~40654~~)。
description.en:
The region ID of the bastion host.

> For more information about the mapping between region IDs and region names, see [Regions and zones](~~40654~~).

description.zh:
要禁用的授权规则ID。
> 您可以调用[ListRules](~~2758868~~)接口获取该参数。
description.en:
The ID of the authorization rule to be disabled.

> You can call the [ListRules](~~2758868~~) operation to query the authorization rule ID to be disabled.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun yundun-bastionhost disable-rule --instance-id bastionhost-cn-78v1gh0000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --rule-id 1 --region cn-hangzhou
